name: Prone W-Raise
steps: Lie prone on a mat with your forehead resting on the floor.
Bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees and position your upper arms at a 45-degree angle to your torso, forming the letter 'W'.
Rotate your hands and forearms upward toward the ceiling, driving your elbows slightly back and pinching your shoulder blades together.
Hold the top contraction for two seconds, feeling the deep external rotators of your shoulders activate.
Slowly return your hands and elbows to the floor.
coaching_cues: Keep wrists in line with forearms; avoid bending wrists backward.
Focus on rotating from the shoulder joint rather than lifting with your neck.
